prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Dress Up Your New Companion", "Select a starter accessory to personalize your pet before finalizing your adoption record.", "Starter Accessory"]
1: ["Secure Your Pet & Account Cloud Sync", "Sign in to ensure your pet stats, accessories, and memory state are backed up automatically to the cloud.", "Cloud Backup Enabled", "Continue with Secure Sign-In"]
2: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop", "Your pet is ready on your screen. Learn key shortcuts and tray controls.", "Practice Pet Desktop Commands", "Test dragging, hiding to system tray, and voice/chat controls right now.", "Try right-clicking pet for quick menu", "Finish Onboarding"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay & System Tray Icon", "Configuring display layers, system tray positioning, and pet rendering engines.", "Initializing overlay layer...", "System Tray Enabled"]
4: ["Select Ready-Made or Custom Pet Path", "Choose an instant ready-to-play companion or build a unique pet using your own photos.", "Continue with Path"]
5: ["Upload 1-3 clear, front-facing photos with good lighting and unobstructed facial features for best pet generation results."]
6: ["Compare Pet Personalities & Behaviors", "View idle animations and idle behaviors side-by-side to pick your ideal companion.", "Select Companion"]
7: ["Rendering Desktop Companion", "An audio chime and desktop notification will alert you as soon as your pet is ready to spawn.", "Audio Alert Enabled"]
8: ["Complete Setup & Claim Your Welcome Gift!", "Your desktop companion is ready. Claim your free starter accessory for completing setup.", "Claim Gift & Launch Pet", "Free Starter Gift Included"]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photos of user's face).
